prompts.name: electric-cottage
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one standalone game asset: a cozy small house for Pokemon characters to live in. Match the provided character artwork: thin slightly organic dark ink outlines, softly painted watercolor/gouache-like color fills, simple cel shading with subtle brush texture, rounded appealing proportions, classic 2D Pokemon illustration. Not a glossy 3D render, not pixel art. Three-quarter front view with front door and right side visible, gently elevated camera, entire building centered in a square 1024x1024 canvas with generous clear margins, consistent scale. A real habitable house with a large inviting door and windows, no face or eyes on the building. Isolate house and its attached doorstep ONLY on a genuinely transparent alpha background; no ground patch, landscape, sky, white fill, checkerboard pattern, cast shadow outside the silhouette, text, labels, watermark, or characters. Keep details readable at small game-icon scale. Subject: electric cottage for Pikachu, warm pale yellow plaster walls, chunky dark warm-brown gabled roof with gently upturned eaves, a small lightning-bolt roof finial, two round windows with muted red frames, rounded wooden door, a short attached cream stone doorstep. Charming domestic architecture, subtle electric motifs, not a house shaped like a character. Reference images are STYLE and PALETTE references only; do not reproduce the character.
